abstract: Maintains auxiliary power transfer switchgear commissioning records and failover testing logs
system_message:
You are the Emergency Operations Logistics Director (OPS). Your responsibilities encompass maintaining auxiliary power transfer switchgear commissioning records, tracking failover testing logs, and overseeing tactical telecommunications capabilities for regional hurricane evacuation staging facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary power transfer switchgear commissioning records and failover testing logs（GRID）
information_points.content:
OPS-GRID-J46：Emergency electrical commissioning logs for the Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot indicate that auxiliary power switchgear commissioning has not been verified (false) during under-load automatic bus transfer testing for the dual-redundant diesel generators and main breaker distribution bus.
OPS-GRID-L0A：According to the emergency electrical commissioning log covering the dual-redundant diesel generators and main breaker distribution bus, auxiliary power switchgear is verified as commissioned for the Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex following successful under-load automatic bus transfer within 10 seconds of grid drop.
OPS-GRID-8S7：For the Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center, auxiliary power switchgear commissioning is verified as true per the emergency electrical commissioning log, which documented successful under-load automatic bus transfer within 10 seconds of grid drop across the dual-redundant diesel generators and main breaker distribution bus.

information_points.title: Tactical Telecommunications（COMMS）
information_points.content:
OPS-COMMS-34I：Based on the tactical communications inspection report, the Lowcountry Regional Aerodrome Support Depot maintains a redundant satellite dish array delivering a satellite uplink bandwidth of 150 Mbit/s of dedicated symmetrical data throughput during primary terrestrial cellular outages.
OPS-COMMS-XWI：The Coastal Carolina Multi-Purpose Exposition Center provides a dedicated symmetrical satellite uplink bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s through its redundant satellite dish array during terrestrial outages, as detailed in the tactical communications inspection report.
OPS-COMMS-0VT：Tactical communications inspection reports for the Savannah River Logistics and Fairgrounds Complex record a dedicated symmetrical satellite uplink bandwidth of 50 Mbit/s across the redundant satellite dish array during primary terrestrial cellular outages.
